decision_time: recorded order_purchase_timestamp; original ingestion time not independently attested
source: olist_orders_dataset.csv order_purchase_timestamp only; deterministic calendar transforms; no joins, delivery estimates, status, seller, item, payment, freight or customer fields in model inputs
label: Among comparable delivered orders only: actual delivery calendar date later than estimated delivery calendar date. Not contractual SLA. Undelivered, cancelled, malformed or unresolved excluded, never coded negative.
maturity: Purchase valid; delivered status; actual delivery >= purchase; estimated date >= purchase calendar date; actual delivery strictly before cutoff and estimated calendar day strictly before cutoff. Archived final status is not an independent historical status log.
model: StandardScaler then fixed unweighted LogisticRegression C=0.1 max_iter=700 random_state=20261125; sigmoid recalibration fit on January only; no later selection or tuning
uncertainty: 500 calendar-week cluster bootstrap replicates conditional on fitted model; percentile 95% intervals; small number of weeks makes March intervals descriptive
holdout: No independently established untouched Olist cohort. All new Olist results are retrospective diagnostics; no deployment or probability certification.
